description: This file defines the 'jiradbInterface' class, which extends 'issueTrackerInterface' and provides methods for connecting to a Jira database, retrieving issues, and managing Jira-specific configurations within a test management system.

classes.name: jiradbInterface
classes.description: Class for interfacing with Jira database, managing issues, statuses, and configuration settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes database connection, configuration, and status settings.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes configuration by parsing the Jira version and validating it.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves issue details from Jira database based on issue ID.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Fetches and stores Jira issue statuses.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a Jira issue ID.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for Jira database configuration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issues can be created via API (returns false).
